scripts.title: Noli Animations
scripts.features: once again the same script, but with noli's animations this time.
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function setupAnimations(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    -- Disable Animate if present
    local animate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animate then
        animate.Disabled = true
    end

    -- Load custom animations
    local idleAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    idleAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://83465205704188"

    local moveAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    moveAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://103292185212679"

    local idleTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(idleAnim)
    local moveTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(moveAnim)

    idleTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action  -- Higher than Core
    moveTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    idleTrack:Play()

    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local speed = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude

        -- Force-stop other idle animations
        for _, track in pairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
            if track.Animation.AnimationId ~= idleAnim.AnimationId
                and track.Animation.AnimationId ~= moveAnim.AnimationId then
                if track.Priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
                    or track.Name == "idle"
                    or track.Animation.AnimationId:lower():find("idle") then
                    track:Stop()
                end
            end
        end

        if speed > 0.01 then
            if not moveTrack.IsPlaying then
                idleTrack:Stop()
                moveTrack:Play()
            end
        else
            if not idleTrack.IsPlaying then
                moveTrack:Stop()
                idleTrack:Play()
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Support for current and future character loads
if player.Character then
    setupAnimations(player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupAnimations)

hi everyone! ever wanted to.. have custom lms? well, here's a solution for you:
this script gives you ability to replace every single lms [for example, A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN), or Through Patches of Violet] to custom .mp3 file.
and also it supports lobby theme. cool.

[HOW-TO CUSTOM LMS]
1. download any song that you want to have as lms
example, Eternal Hope, Eternal Fight as A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN)
2. put the .mp3 file to the Workspace folder of your executor
3. rename the .mp3 to original lms theme (in this example, A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN))
4. in result, you should have "A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN).mp3"
5. run the script

[CREDITS]
1. thanks to Forsaken development team for creating this game
2. thanks to musicians working on Forsaken for making good OST for the game
3. you for using this script
scripts.script:
-- PLEASE READ DESCRIPTION BEFORE USING!!!
-- downloading Eternal Hope, Eternal Fight (oldest forsaken lms) and replacing it with current lms
local response = request({
    Url = "https://r2.e-z.host/280bafea-4583-489d-99c5-cfbd5c3242a8/xbueonwz.mp3",
    Method = "GET"
})

if response.StatusCode == 200 then
    writefile("A GRAVE SOUL (NOW, RUN).mp3", response.Body)
end
